question: What is the meaning of energy consumption in relation to sustainability features?
description: Energy consumption is a key parameter in assessing the sustainability of materials or products, as it directly impacts the environmental footprint of a building or construction project. In the context of sustainability features, energy consumption is evaluated in terms of the energy required for the production, use, and end-of-life stages of materials or products. Lower energy consumption indicates a more sustainable material or product, as it implies reduced environmental impact and resource use. This parameter is crucial in the calculation of the Linear Flow Index (LFI) and Material Circularity Indicator (MCI), which are used to assess the sustainability of materials or products comprehensively and transparently.
